name: im-connector
description: Extensible IM connector: a single MCP passthrough that routes to DingTalk (dws) and WeCom (wecom-cli), with a provider registry ready for Feishu/Discord and more.

scripts.build:bundle: pnpm build && esbuild src/plugin/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --outfile=im-connect/index.js --banner:js="import { createRequire as __esmRequire } from 'node:module'; var require = __esmRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.verify: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm smoke:mcp
